plan.title: Brain 2x2 genotype x drug interaction DE + pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question — does the drug act differently in KO vs WT brain — is a classic 2x2 factorial interaction question (genotype: WT/KO x treatment: vehicle/drug, n=4/cell, 16 samples, 12000 genes, raw salmon counts). The correct test is not four pairwise comparisons but the genotype:treatment interaction term in a single DESeq2 model with design ~genotype*treatment. QC first establishes sample structure and rules out a mislabeled or outlier sample among the 16. Low-count genes are minimally pre-filtered (>=10 counts in >=4 samples, the smallest cell size), and DESeq2's internal median-of-ratios normalization and independent filtering do the rest. The Wald test on the interaction coefficient (genotypeKO.treatmentdrug) directly answers whether the drug effect differs by genotype; because that coefficient is a difference-of-differences with low power at n=4/cell, the plan also reports the simple effects (drug vs vehicle within WT, and within KO) so a non-significant interaction is not misread as 'no drug effect at all'. LFC shrinkage uses ashr (contrasts, not single coefficients, for the simple effects; interaction coefficient shrinkage also via ashr for consistency). BH-FDR at alpha=0.05 with independent filtering, DESeq2 defaults (count-outlier NA flagging kept on, reported separately since n=4/cell is below the 7-replicate threshold for replacement). Enrichment (fgsea preranked on the Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark) is run separately on the interaction ranking and on each simple-effect ranking, to interpret which pathways respond differently to the drug depending on genotype versus which respond similarly. All choices (reference levels WT/vehicle, contrast naming, ranking statistic, gene set size window 15-500, redundant set collapsing) are stated explicitly per the sourced procedure so the report is reproducible. Both DESeq2 and MSigDB Hallmark availability are unconfirmed in this environment and are checked at each step; if fgsea or the Hallmark gene sets are unavailable, the enrichment step reports that gap rather than fabricating pathway results.

ashr shrinkage for interaction and simple-effect contrasts
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald stat vs MSigDB Hallmark
structured report with design, contrasts, thresholds, n tested, n DE, session info
